versos.hebraico: וְֽ֠הָיָה מִסְפַּ֤ר בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כְּח֣וֹל הַיָּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יִמַּ֖ד וְלֹ֣א יִסָּפֵ֑ר וְֽ֠הָיָה בִּמְק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יֵאָמֵ֤ר לָהֶם֙ לֹֽא־עַמִּ֣י אַתֶּ֔ם יֵאָמֵ֥ר לָהֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י אֵֽל־חָֽי׃

controles.web: Yet the number of the children of Israel will be as the sand of the sea, which can’t be measured nor numbered; and it will come to pass that, in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’
controles.kjv: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.
controles.livre: Todavia o número dos filhos de Israel será como a areia do mar, que não se pode medir nem contar. E acontecerá que, onde foi lhes dito: Vós não sois meu povo, será lhes dito: Vós sois filhos do Deus vivo.

versos.hebraico: וְ֠נִקְבְּצוּ בְּנֵֽי־יְהוּדָ֤ה וּבְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו וְשָׂמ֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם רֹ֥אשׁ אֶחָ֖ד וְעָל֣וּ מִן־הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י גָד֖וֹל י֥וֹם יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃

controles.web: The children of Judah and the children of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint themselves one head, and will go up from the land; for great will be the day of Jezreel.
controles.kjv: Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Judá e de Israel serão reunidos em um, e levantarão para si uma única cabeça,  e subirão da terra; pois o dia de Jezreel será grande.

versos.hebraico: אִמְר֥וּ לַאֲחֵיכֶ֖ם עַמִּ֑י וְלַאֲחֽוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם רֻחָֽמָה׃

controles.web: “Say to your brothers, ‘My people!’  and to your sisters, ‘My loved one!’
controles.kjv: Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ru–hamah.
controles.livre: Dizei a vossos irmãos: Meu Povo, e vossas irmãs: Amada.

versos.hebraico: רִ֤יבוּ בְאִמְּכֶם֙ רִ֔יבוּ כִּֽי־הִיא֙ לֹ֣א אִשְׁתִּ֔י וְאָנֹכִ֖י לֹ֣א אִישָׁ֑הּ וְתָסֵ֤ר זְנוּנֶ֨יהָ֙ מִפָּנֶ֔יה וְנַאֲפוּפֶ֖יהָ מִבֵּ֥ין שָׁדֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: Contend with your mother! Contend, for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband; and let her put away her prostitution from her face, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
controles.kjv: Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
controles.livre: Repreendei vossa mãe, repreendei; porque ela não é minha mulher, nem eu seu marido; que tire suas prostituições diante de si, e seus adultérios dentre seus peitos;

versos.hebraico: פֶּן־אַפְשִׁיטֶ֣נָּה עֲרֻמָּ֔ה וְהִ֨צַּגְתִּ֔יהָ כְּי֖וֹם הִוָּֽלְדָ֑הּ וְשַׂמְתִּ֣יהָ כַמִּדְבָּ֗ר וְשַׁתִּ֨הָ֙ כְּאֶ֣רֶץ צִיָּ֔ה וַהֲמִתִּ֖יהָ בַּצָּמָֽא׃

controles.web: Lest I strip her naked, and make her bare as in the day that she was born, and make her like a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and kill her with thirst.
controles.kjv: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.
controles.livre: Para não acontecer que eu a deixe nua, e a ponha como no dia em que nasceu, e a faça como um deserto, e a deixe como terra seca, e a mate de sede.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־בָּנֶ֖יהָ לֹ֣א אֲרַחֵ֑ם כִּֽי־בְנֵ֥י זְנוּנִ֖ים הֵֽמָּה׃

controles.web: Indeed, on her children I will have no mercy; for they are children of unfaithfulness;
controles.kjv: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they be the children of whoredoms.
controles.livre: E não terei compaixão de seus filhos, porque são filhos de prostituições.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י זָֽנְתָה֙ אִמָּ֔ם הֹבִ֖ישָׁה הֽוֹרָתָ֑ם כִּ֣י אָמְרָ֗ה אֵלְכָ֞ה אַחֲרֵ֤י מְאַהֲבַי֙ נֹתְנֵ֤י לַחְמִי֙ וּמֵימַ֔י צַמְרִ֣י וּפִשְׁתִּ֔י שַׁמְנִ֖י וְשִׁקּוּיָֽי׃

controles.web: For their mother has played the prostitute. She who conceived them has done shamefully; for she said, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.’
controles.kjv: For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.
controles.livre: Pois sua mãe se prostituiu; a que os concebeu age de forma vergonhosa; porque disse: Irei atrás meus amantes, que dão meu pão e minha água, minha lã e meu linho, meu azeite e minha bebida.

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֛ן הִנְנִי־שָׂ֥ךְ אֶת־דַּרְכֵּ֖ךְ בַּסִּירִ֑ים וְגָֽדַרְתִּי֙ אֶת־גְּדֵרָ֔הּ וּנְתִיבוֹתֶ֖יהָ לֹ֥א תִמְצָֽא׃

controles.web: Therefore behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and I will build a wall against her, that she can’t find her way.
controles.kjv: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.
controles.livre: Portanto eis que cercarei teu caminho com espinhos, e levantarei uma parede de sebe, de modo que ela não poderá achar suas veredas.

versos.hebraico: וְרִדְּפָ֤ה אֶת־מְאַהֲבֶ֨יהָ֙ וְלֹֽא־תַשִּׂ֣יג אֹתָ֔ם וּבִקְשָׁ֖תַם וְלֹ֣א תִמְצָ֑א וְאָמְרָ֗ה אֵלְכָ֤ה וְאָשׁ֨וּבָה֙ אֶל־אִישִׁ֣י הָֽרִאשׁ֔וֹן כִּ֣י ט֥וֹב לִ֛י אָ֖ז מֵעָֽתָּה׃

controles.web: She will follow after her lovers, but she won’t overtake them; and she will seek them, but won’t find them. Then she will say, ‘I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.’
controles.kjv: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.
controles.livre: E ela correrá atrás de seus amantes, mas não os alcançará; ela os buscará, mas não os achará. Então dirá: Irei, e me voltarei ao meu primeiro marido; porque era melhor para mim então do que agora.

versos.hebraico: וְהִיא֙ לֹ֣א יָֽדְעָ֔ה כִּ֤י אָֽנֹכִי֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔הּ הַדָּגָ֖ן וְהַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָ֑ר וְכֶ֨סֶף הִרְבֵּ֥יתִי לָ֛הּ וְזָהָ֖ב עָשׂ֥וּ לַבָּֽעַל׃

controles.web: For she did not know that I gave her the grain, the new wine, and the oil, and multiplied to her silver and gold, which they used for Baal.
controles.kjv: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.
controles.livre: E ela não reconhecia que era eu que lhe dava o trigo, o vinho, e o azeite, e lhe multiplicava a prata e o ouro que usavam para Baal.

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֣ן אָשׁ֔וּב וְלָקַחְתִּ֤י דְגָנִי֙ בְּעִתּ֔וֹ וְתִירוֹשִׁ֖י בְּמֽוֹעֲד֑וֹ וְהִצַּלְתִּי֙ צַמְרִ֣י וּפִשְׁתִּ֔י לְכַסּ֖וֹת אֶת־עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃

controles.web: Therefore I will take back my grain in its time, and my new wine in its season, and will pluck away my wool and my flax which should have covered her nakedness.
controles.kjv: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.
controles.livre: Portanto tomarei de volta meu trigo a seu tempo, e meu vinho à sua estação, e tirarei minha lã e meu linho que servia para cobrir sua nudez.

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּ֛ה אֲגַלֶּ֥ה אֶת־נַבְלֻתָ֖הּ לְעֵינֵ֣י מְאַהֲבֶ֑יהָ וְאִ֖ישׁ לֹֽא־יַצִּילֶ֥נָּה מִיָּדִֽי׃

controles.web: Now I will uncover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and no one will deliver her out of my hand.
controles.kjv: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of mine hand.
controles.livre: E agora deixarei exposta sua loucura diante dos olhos de seus amantes, e ninguém a livrará de minha mão.

versos.hebraico: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי֙ כָּל־מְשׂוֹשָׂ֔הּ חַגָּ֖הּ חָדְשָׁ֣הּ וְשַׁבַּתָּ֑הּ וְכֹ֖ל מוֹעֲדָֽהּ׃

controles.web: I will also cause all her celebrations to cease: her feasts, her new moons, her Sabbaths, and all her solemn assemblies.
controles.kjv: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.
controles.livre: E farei cessar toda a sua alegria, suas festas, suas novas luas e seus sábados, e todas as suas festividades.

versos.hebraico: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִ֗י גַּפְנָהּ֙ וּתְאֵ֣נָתָ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמְרָ֗ה אֶתְנָ֥ה הֵ֨מָּה֙ לִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתְנוּ־לִ֖י מְאַֽהֲבָ֑י וְשַׂמְתִּ֣ים לְיַ֔עַר וַאֲכָלָ֖תַם חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃

controles.web: I will lay waste her vines and her fig trees, about which she has said, ‘These are my wages that my lovers have given me; and I will make them a forest,’ and the animals of the field shall eat them.
controles.kjv: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she hath said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.
controles.livre: E destruirei suas vides e suas figueiras, das quais diz: Estas são meu salário, que meus amantes me deram. E as reduzirei a uma matagal, e os animais do campo as comerão.

versos.hebraico: וּפָקַדְתִּ֣י עָלֶ֗יהָ אֶת־יְמֵ֤י הַבְּעָלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּקְטִ֣יר לָהֶ֔ם וַתַּ֤עַד נִזְמָהּ֙ וְחֶלְיָתָ֔הּ וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ אַחֲרֵ֣י מְאַהֲבֶ֑יהָ וְאֹתִ֥י שָׁכְחָ֖ה נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: I will visit on her the days of the Baals, to which she burned incense, when she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and went after her lovers, and forgot me,” says Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgat me, saith the Lord.
controles.livre: E eu a punirei pelos dias em que ela queimava incensos a Baal, e se adornava de seus pendentes e de suas joias, e seguia seus amantes, tendo se esquecido de mim,diz o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֗ן הִנֵּ֤ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ מְפַתֶּ֔יהָ וְהֹֽלַכְתִּ֖יהָ הַמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְדִבַּרְתִּ֖י עַל לִבָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: “Therefore behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak tenderly to her.
controles.kjv: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.
controles.livre: Porém eis que eu a atrairei, e a levarei ao deserto, e falarei a seu coração.

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַ֨תִּי לָ֤הּ אֶת־כְּרָמֶ֨יהָ֙ מִשָּׁ֔ם וְאֶת־עֵ֥מֶק עָכ֖וֹר לְפֶ֣תַח תִּקְוָ֑ה וְעָ֤נְתָה שָּׁ֨מָּה֙ כִּימֵ֣י נְעוּרֶ֔יהָ וִּכְי֖וֹם עֲלֹתָ֥הּ מֵאֶֽרֶץ־מִצְרָֽיִם׃ס

controles.web: I will give her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will respond there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
controles.kjv: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
controles.livre: E desde ali lhe darei suas vinhas, e o vale de Acor por porta de esperança; e ali ela cantará como nos tempos de sua juventude, como no dia em que subiu da terra do Egito.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֤ה בַיּוֹם־הַהוּא֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה תִּקְרְאִ֖י אִישִׁ֑י וְלֹֽא־תִקְרְאִי־לִ֥י ע֖וֹד בַּעְלִֽי׃

controles.web: It will be in that day,” says Yahweh, “that you will call me ‘my husband,’ and no longer call me ‘my master.’
controles.kjv: And it shall be at that day, saith the Lord, that thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.
controles.livre: E será naquele dia, diz o SENHOR, me chamarás de meu marido, e não mais me chamarás de meu Baal.

versos.hebraico: וַהֲסִרֹתִ֛י אֶת־שְׁמ֥וֹת הַבְּעָלִ֖ים מִפִּ֑יהָ וְלֹֽא־יִזָּכְר֥וּ ע֖וֹד בִּשְׁמָֽם׃

controles.web: For I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and they will no longer be mentioned by name.
controles.kjv: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.
controles.livre: Porque tirarei de sua boca os nomes dos baalins, e nunca mais serão lembrados por seus nomes.

versos.hebraico: וְכָרַתִּ֨י לָהֶ֤ם בְּרִית֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא עִם־חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וְעִם־ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְרֶ֖מֶשׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה וְקֶ֨שֶׁת וְחֶ֤רֶב וּמִלְחָמָה֙ אֶשְׁבּ֣וֹר מִן־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהִשְׁכַּבְתִּ֖ים לָבֶֽטַח׃

controles.web: In that day I will make a covenant for them with the animals of the field, and with the birds of the sky, and with the creeping things of the ground. I will break the bow, the sword, and the battle out of the land, and will make them lie down safely.
controles.kjv: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.
controles.livre: E naquele dia farei por eles uma aliança com os animais do campo, as aves do céu, e os répteis da terra; e quebrarei o arco, a espada, e a batalha da terra, e os farei deitar em segurança.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵרַשְׂתִּ֥יךְ לִ֖י לְעוֹלָ֑ם וְאֵרַשְׂתִּ֥יךְ לִי֙ בְּצֶ֣דֶק וּבְמִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּבְחֶ֖סֶד וּֽבְרַחֲמִֽים׃

controles.web: I will betroth you to me forever. Yes, I will betroth you to me in righteousness, in justice, in loving kindness, and in compassion.
controles.kjv: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.
controles.livre: E te farei minha esposa para sempre; eu te farei minha esposa em justiça, juízo, bondade e misericórdias.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵרַשְׂתִּ֥יךְ לִ֖י בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה וְיָדַ֖עַתְּ אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: I will even betroth you to me in faithfulness; and you shall know Yahweh.
controles.kjv: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the Lord.
controles.livre: E te farei minha esposa em fidelidade, e tu conhecerás ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא אֶֽעֱנֶה֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה אֶעֱנֶ֖ה אֶת־הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְהֵ֖ם יַעֲנ֥וּ אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: It will happen in that day, I will respond,” says Yahweh, “I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth;
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the Lord, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;
controles.livre: E será que naquele tempo responderei,diz o SENHOR, eu responderei ao céu, e ele responderá à terra;

versos.hebraico: וְהָאָ֣רֶץ תַּעֲנֶ֔ה אֶת־הַדָּגָ֖ן וְאֶת־הַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְאֶת־הַיִּצְהָ֑ר וְהֵ֖ם יַעֲנ֥וּ אֶֽת־יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃

controles.web: and the earth will respond to the grain, and the new wine, and the oil; and they will respond to Jezreel.
controles.kjv: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.
controles.livre: E a terra responderá ao trigo, ao vinho, e ao azeite; e eles responderão a Jezreel.

versos.hebraico: וּזְרַעְתִּ֤יהָ לִּי֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְרִֽחַמְתִּ֖י אֶת־לֹ֣א רֻחָ֑מָה וְאָמַרְתִּ֤י לְלֹֽא־עַמִּי֙ עַמִּי־אַ֔תָּה וְה֖וּא יֹאמַ֥ר אֱלֹהָֽי׃פ

controles.web: I will sow her to me in the earth; and I will have mercy on her who had not obtained mercy; and I will tell those who were not my people, ‘You are my people;’ and they will say, ‘My God!’”
controles.kjv: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them which were not my people, Thou art my people; and they shall say, Thou art my God.
controles.livre: E eu a semearei para mim na terra; amarei a Não-Amada; e direi a Não-Meu-Povo: Tu és meu povo; e ele dirá: Tu és meu Deus.
